params.name: opts
params.type: PoiNodeOptions (跟 add 一样, 但支持 onClick / onHover 回调)

params.name: opts.onClick
params.desc: 点击 POI 时的回调

params.name: opts.onHover
params.desc: 鼠标悬停 POI 时的回调

code: const node = ssp.poiManager.addNode({ text: 'A_6F', position: { x: 0, y: 30, z: 0 }, color: '#ff5722' }); console.log('poi node:', node.id);
example: const a6 = ssp.objectsTool.getByUserDataProperty('floorName', 'A_6F')[0]; const pos = a6 ? { x: 0, y: 50, z: 0 } : { x: 0, y: 30, z: 0 }; const node = ssp.poiManager.addNode({ text: 'A_6F - 点击查看', position: pos, color: '#29ccff' }); console.log('created:', node.id);
guard: addNode 跟 add 接口一致, 区别在交互层
v1 实现: 节点版和普通 POI 渲染一样 (Sprite + canvas), 后续可加 click/hover 事件
